policy: A migration is not marked applied merely because a file exists or because a historical comment says it was applied. The live migration journal and target database state must agree.

migrations.historicalClaim: Different Supabase project id was named in the original comment
migrations.requiredAction: Inspect live function/trigger/publication state, then either apply to target project or document equivalent pre-existing live objects and reconcile migration history through an approved process.

migrations.historicalClaim: Original comment said Applied live without naming target project
migrations.requiredAction: Inspect supabase_realtime publication for notifications and reconcile through approved migration process.

migrations.historicalClaim: Prepared migration; no live-apply claim now
migrations.requiredAction: Inspect private.complete_task definition against the target database before any apply.

migrations.historicalClaim: Prepared migration; duplicate function definition appears in 20261001110000
migrations.requiredAction: Determine whether this migration is duplicate/reconciliation-only before application; do not run both blindly.
